app.name: MedNow
app.demoNotice: Demo data: practices, addresses, doctors and appointments are fictional.

emergency.disclaimer: MedNow does not replace medical advice. If life is at risk, call 112 immediately.
emergency.moreA11y: Open emergency page: emergency pharmacy, on-call doctor, crisis line

welcome.title: We’ll quickly find an appointment for you.
welcome.body: Free doctor appointments near you – shown honestly, booked in seconds.

location.title: Where are you looking?
location.body: With your location we show nearby practices and how far away they are. We only use it while you use the app and never store it.
location.postalCodeNotFound: We don’t know this postcode. Check it or use your location.
location.denied: No problem – just enter your postcode.

forWhom.title: Who are you looking for?
forWhom.ageHint: We only ask for the age group, never a date of birth.

interests.title: Which specialties do you need most?
interests.body: Optional – they’ll appear first on the home screen.

home.heroBody: We'll show you right away where something is free soon.
home.heroCount_one: {{count}} practice with free appointments in the next 24 h
home.heroCount_other: {{count}} practices with free appointments in the next 24 h
home.heroNone: Fully booked for the next 24 hours – here are the earliest appointments.
home.heroA11yHint: Shows nearby practices sorted by the earliest free appointment
home.nearbyWeek_one: Nothing in the next 24 hours – {{count}} practice this week
home.nearbyWeek_other: Nothing in the next 24 hours – {{count}} practices this week

card.noSlotInWindow: No free appointment in this period

acute.title: Available soon
acute.subtitle: Next 24 hours: earliest appointment first, then the shortest distance.
acute.noneToday: Nothing available in the next 24 hours – earliest {{when}}.
acute.unknownHint: Best to give them a quick call.
acute.alarmBody: As soon as a matching appointment opens up in the next 24 hours.

search.title: Search
search.mapA11y: Map with {{count}} practices. The same practices are listed below.
search.clusterA11y: {{count}} practices in this area. Double tap to zoom in
search.mapUnavailable: The map isn’t available here. You’ll find all practices in the list.

practice.routeA11y: Open directions in your maps app

banner.unknown: No current appointment data – please call

practice.accessibilityNone: No accessibility information. Best to ask the practice.
practice.reviewsComingSoon: We’ll show individual reviews once there is a fair verification process.

booking.title: Book appointment
booking.holdNotice: We’re holding this appointment for you for {{minutes}} minutes.
booking.holdEndingA11y: One minute left before the appointment is released again.
booking.dependentNameHint: Only for you to tell them apart, e.g. “Mia”.
booking.reasonHint: Optional. Helps the practice plan. Please don’t share details about symptoms.
booking.contactHint: The practice needs this to reach you if anything changes.
booking.phoneInvalid: Please enter a valid phone number, e.g. 0661 123456.
booking.verifyBody: One time only: we’ll send you a 6-digit code so only you can manage your appointments.
booking.codeInvalid: That code isn’t right. Check it or request a new one.
booking.consentText: I consent to MedNow processing my appointment data and sending it to the chosen practice. This may reveal which specialty I am seeing (health data, Art. 9 GDPR). I can withdraw my consent at any time in the privacy centre.
booking.consentRequired: We can’t book the appointment without this consent.
booking.successBody: The practice has received your booking.
booking.remindersDenied: Notifications are off. You can allow them in your system settings.

errors.slotTaken: This appointment was just taken. Simply choose another time – the next free ones are right below.
errors.holdExpired: The reservation has expired. Just choose the appointment again.
errors.consentMissing: Please confirm your consent to book.
errors.verificationRequired: Please confirm your email address first.

appointments.title: My appointments
appointments.cancelConfirmBody: The appointment will be released so someone else can use it.
appointments.cancelled: Appointment cancelled. The slot is now free for others.
appointments.emptyUpcoming: No appointments yet. When you book one, you’ll find it here.
appointments.emptyPast: Your past appointments will appear here.

waitlist.title: Appointment alert
waitlist.body: When a matching appointment becomes free, you get a notification right away. Tap it and the appointment is reserved for you for 10 minutes – one more tap to book.
waitlist.joined: Your appointment alert is active. We’ll let you know as soon as something opens up.
waitlist.pushBody: To let you know right away, we need permission to send notifications. We only send messages about your appointment alerts.
waitlist.pushDenied: Without notifications we can only reach you in the app: open offers appear under “Appointments”.

offer.title: An appointment just opened up!
offer.expired: This reservation has expired. Your appointment alert stays active.
offer.declined: All right. We’ll pass it on and let you know about the next one.
offer.endingA11y: One minute left before the appointment goes to the next person.

notifications.offerBody: An appointment near you just opened up. Tap to confirm.
notifications.reminder24h: Your doctor’s appointment is tomorrow at {{time}}.
notifications.reminder2h: Your doctor’s appointment starts in 2 hours ({{time}}).
notifications.leaveNow: Time to leave: your doctor’s appointment starts at {{time}}.
notifications.leaveNowTravel: Time to leave: your doctor’s appointment starts at {{time}} ({{travel}}).

profile.title: Profile
profile.familyHint: Family members you book appointments for.
profile.reminders: Appointment reminders (24 h and 2 h before)
profile.anonymous: No account – your data stays on this device and in your anonymous session.
profile.leaveReminderHint: Reminds you when it’s time to leave – estimated from distance and travel mode.

privacy.title: Privacy centre
privacy.intro: See what you have consented to and change it at any time.
privacy.revokeHealthBody: Without this consent you can’t book new appointments. Existing appointments remain.
privacy.crashReportsHint: Helps us fix bugs. No names, contact details, appointments or location. Servers in the EU (Frankfurt).
privacy.exportHint: A file with everything we have stored about you.
privacy.exportCopied: Your data was copied to the clipboard as JSON.
privacy.exportUnavailable: Export isn’t available in this browser. The app gives you a file.
privacy.deleteConfirmBody: Upcoming appointments will be cancelled, appointment alerts ended and all data deleted. This cannot be undone.
privacy.locationHint: Only while in use, rounded to about 100 m, never stored.

legal.placeholder: Placeholder – to be reviewed by a lawyer before launch.
legal.imprintBody: Information pursuant to § 5 DDG will be added before launch: provider name and address, authorised representatives, contact, register entry, VAT ID.
legal.privacyBody: Before launch, the privacy policy will describe: controller, purposes and legal bases (incl. Art. 9(2)(a) GDPR), recipients (practices, processors in the EU), retention periods, data subject rights and the right to lodge a complaint.
legal.termsBody: Before launch, the terms of use will cover appointment brokering, cancellations and the exclusion of medical advice.
legal.accessibilityBody: MedNow aims to meet WCAG 2.1 level AA (German Accessibility Strengthening Act). Known limitations and a contact for reporting barriers will be added before launch.
legal.helpBody: MedNow shows free appointments at practices. For urgent complaints outside opening hours, the medical on-call service helps at 116117. If life is at risk, call 112.
legal.licensesIntro: MedNow uses open-source software and open data.
legal.osmAttribution: Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors, available under the Open Database License (ODbL).
legal.fontsAttribution: Fonts: Inter and Plus Jakarta Sans (SIL Open Font License 1.1).

errors.generic: That didn’t work. Please try again.
errors.network: No connection. Check your internet and try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests. Please wait a moment.

offline.banner: Offline – you’re seeing the last loaded results.

empty.radius: Nothing is free within {{radius}} km right now.
empty.noLocationBody: Enter your postcode or allow location access.

showcase.title: Components
showcase.toastSample: This is what a confirmation looks like.

diagnostics.title: Test build & diagnostics
diagnostics.intro: This page only exists in test builds. The details help with feedback and contain no personal data.
diagnostics.startupHint: Measured from the start of the app logic to the first usable screen. For a new measurement, close the app completely and open it again. The time before that (process start, splash screen) is measured by scripts/measure-startup.sh.
diagnostics.accessibilityHint: Helps with feedback on screen readers, text size and motion. Test plan: docs/accessibility-audit.md.
diagnostics.updateNone: The app is up to date.
diagnostics.updateReady: Update downloaded – the app will restart.
diagnostics.updateFailed: The update could not be downloaded. Please try again later.

travel.title: Getting there
travel.note: Estimated from straight-line distance. Exact time in your maps app.
travel.preferred: How do you usually get to the practice?

calendarSync.title: Calendar sync
calendarSync.hint: Appointments automatically in a separate “MedNow” calendar on this device
calendarSync.enabled_one: Calendar sync is on. {{count}} appointment added.
calendarSync.enabled_other: Calendar sync is on. {{count}} appointments added.
calendarSync.denied: Calendar sync needs calendar access. You can still add appointments one by one.
calendarSync.unavailable: The calendar isn’t available on this device right now.
calendarSync.offBody: The “MedNow” calendar and all its entries will be removed from this device. Your appointments stay booked.

favorites.added: Practice saved – it’s now on your home screen.

emergencyPage.title: Emergency & help
emergencyPage.entryHint: Emergency number, on-call doctor, emergency pharmacy, crisis line
emergencyPage.lifeBody: For unconsciousness, shortness of breath, severe chest pain, signs of a stroke, serious accidents or heavy bleeding, call 112 immediately.
emergencyPage.onCallBody: When it can’t wait until the next surgery hours but isn’t an emergency for the ambulance service – for example at night, at weekends or on public holidays. Free of charge, nationwide.
emergencyPage.pharmacyBody: The pharmacists’ chambers’ search shows which pharmacy is on duty right now. By phone, a voice service asks for your postcode and names the nearest pharmacies on duty.
emergencyPage.pharmacySource: Data: emergency search of the pharmacists’ chambers (aponet.de). MedNow has no pharmacy data of its own.
emergencyPage.crisisBody: The TelefonSeelsorge crisis line is available around the clock – free and anonymous (in German).

checkups.title: Check-ups
checkups.entryHint: Which check-ups statutory insurance covers – with reminders
checkups.intro: Statutory health insurance covers these screening and preventive check-ups. You choose what we should remind you of.
checkups.disclaimer: Not medical advice. Whether and when a check-up makes sense is something to discuss with your practice. As of 10/2026; private insurance may differ.
checkups.ageMissing: Add your age and we’ll only show what fits you.
checkups.doneToast: Great. We’ll remind you again on {{date}}.
checkups.noPush: Without notifications you’ll only see the reminder here in the app.
checkups.consentBody: We only store which check-up you want to be reminded of and when – on this device only, not on our servers. Notifications never name the check-up. You can delete everything at any time.
checkups.notificationBody: A check-up is due. Details in MedNow.

checkup.title: Health check-up
checkup.about: GP examination with blood pressure, blood tests and a talk about previous illnesses.

skin.title: Skin cancer screening
skin.about: Full-body skin examination, e.g. at a dermatologist or GP.

dental.title: Dental check-up
dental.about: Regular check-ups in the bonus booklet can increase the subsidy for dentures.

bowel.title: Bowel cancer screening
bowel.often: stool test every 2 years or two colonoscopies 10 years apart
bowel.about: Discuss with your practice which option suits you.

cervix.title: Cervical cancer screening
cervix.often: yearly; from 35 a combined test every 3 years

breast.title: Mammography screening
breast.about: The invitation arrives by post from the screening programme’s central office.

prostate.title: Cancer screening for men
prostate.about: Examination of the prostate and external genitals, e.g. at a urologist or GP.

aorta.title: Abdominal aorta ultrasound
aorta.about: Early detection of an abdominal aortic aneurysm.

uExams.title: Children’s check-ups U1–U9
uExams.often: as scheduled in the yellow child health booklet
uExams.about: The exact periods are in the booklet – you set the reminder yourself.

dentalChild.title: Dental check-ups for children
dentalChild.about: Early detection up to age 6, then individual prophylaxis.

j1.title: Youth check-up J1
j1.about: Physical examination and a talk, e.g. at a paediatric practice.

plans.entryHint: More appointment alerts, calendar sync, saved practices, check-up reminders

includes.free:
Search, all filters and map
Booking – also for one family member
1 appointment alert (including “available soon”)
Reminders, calendar entry, emergency page
includes.plus:
Everything in Free
Up to 10 appointment alerts at once, up to 60 days
Calendar sync and saved practices
Check-up reminders for you
includes.family:
Everything in Plus
Up to 5 profiles
Check-up reminders for everyone

alarms.title: Several appointment alerts at once
alarms.body: Free includes one active appointment alert. With Plus you can watch up to 10 practices or specialties at once.

longAlarms.title: Appointment alerts for up to 60 days
longAlarms.body: For specialist appointments with long waits: with Plus your alert keeps searching for up to 60 days.

calendar.title: Appointments in your calendar automatically
calendar.body: With Plus, appointments go into the “MedNow” calendar and update when rescheduled or cancelled. Adding them one by one stays free.

favorites.title: Save practices
favorites.body: With Plus you save practices and book them from the home screen in two taps.

checkups.title: Check-up reminders
checkups.body: The overview stays free. With Plus, MedNow reminds you of your check-ups.

familyCheckups.title: Check-ups for the whole family
familyCheckups.body: With MedNow Family you get check-up reminders for every profile – including children’s U-check-ups and J1.

profiles.title: More family profiles
profiles.body: Free covers you and one family member. With MedNow Family you manage up to 5 profiles.

overview.title: MedNow Plus and Family
overview.body: Searching, booking and emergency help are always free. You pay for convenience: more alerts, calendar, saved practices, check-ups.

plans.fairness: Paying never gives priority: appointments that open up go to everyone in the same order, with the same reservation time.
plans.cancelInfo: Yearly plans renew every year after the trial until you cancel them in the App Store or Google Play settings – at any time. We remind you 3 days before the trial ends. The 30-day pass ends by itself.
plans.purchaseFailed: The purchase didn’t work. You were not charged.
plans.demoNotice: Demo version: nothing is charged. The “purchase” only unlocks features on this device.
plans.unavailable: Purchases aren’t available in this version yet. All free features work fully.
plans.trialEndingBody: Your free trial ends in 3 days. You can cancel any time in the store settings.
plans.limitTitle: An appointment alert is already active
plans.limitBody: Free includes one active appointment alert. You can replace the current one or keep several with Plus.

family.limit: Free covers you and one family member. More profiles come with MedNow Family (Profile → Family).
